# 02 - Hybrid RAG Pipeline

A hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over a corpus of policy
documents. Retrieval fuses **sparse** (BM25) and **dense** (vector) search with
**reciprocal rank fusion (RRF)**, then a grounded answer is generated by an LLM
served through OpenRouter. Includes a Streamlit Q&A UI, an offline RAG
evaluation harness, and a unit test suite.

## How it works

```
Question
   │
   ▼
┌─────────────┐   BM25 (sparse) ────────────────┐
│  Retriever   │   Vector (dense)  ─┐            │
└──────┬──────┘                     ▼            ▼
   │              Reciprocal Rank Fusion → Top-k chunks
   ▼
┌─────────────┐   CONTEXT + QUESTION
│  Generation  │   ───────────────────────────────►  Answer
└─────────────┘   (system prompt grounds the LLM in context only)
```

## Project layout

```
app/
  main.py            # Generator, prompt builder, answer() orchestrator
  streamlit_app.py   # Q&A web UI
src/
  knowledge/
    knowledge_base.py  # KnowledgeBase: chunking, indexing, persistence
    embeddings.py      # Embedder: local sentence-transformers / OpenRouter
    retriever.py       # Retriever: BM25 + dense, RRF fusion
  evaluation/
    dataset.py         # eval Q&A dataset (+ YAML loader)
    metrics.py         # hit@k, precision@k, recall@k, MRR
    retrieval.py       # retrieval evaluation harness
    generation.py      # LLM-as-judge: correctness, faithfulness, hallucination
    evaluate.py        # evaluation CLI
  utils/config_loader.py
 02_rag_hybrid/__init__.py   # console entry point (launches Streamlit)
config/llm_config.yaml       # models + embeddings configuration
data/policies/               # knowledge corpus (Aether Wireless policy docs)
tests/                       # pytest suite
```

## Setup

Requires Python >= 3.13 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

```bash
uv sync
cp .env.example .env        # then add your OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

Optionally install the dev dependencies (`pytest`) with
`uv sync --group dev` or `uv pip install pytest`.

## Usage

### Chat UI

```bash
uv run streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py
```

The app builds (and persists) the vector index on first use, then answers
questions with the retrieved chunks shown in an expander.

### Generation via entry point

```bash
uv run 02-rag-hybrid
```

## Evaluation

Run both stages against the built-in dataset:

```bash
uv run python -m src.evaluation.evaluate
```

Retrieval is always evaluated. The generation stage runs only when
`OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is set (add `--skip-generation` to force retrieval-only).

Options:

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--dataset PATH` | YAML list of `{question, expected_answer, expected_source}` |
| `--k-values 1,3,5` | K values for retrieval metrics |
| `--top-k 5` | Chunks fed to the generator |
| `--rebuild` | Rebuild the vector index first |
| `--skip-generation` | Only evaluate retrieval |
| `--output PATH` | Write the full report as JSON |

### Retrieval evaluation

Relevancy is defined by source document: a chunk is relevant when its
`source` matches the question's `expected_source`. Aggregated over all
questions you get **Hit@K, Precision@K, Recall@K, MRR**.

```text
=== Retrieval Evaluation ===
Queries: 6   K values: 1/3/5
  hit_rate@1: 1.000  ...
  recall_at_k@5: 0.692  ...
```

### Generation evaluation

An **LLM-as-judge** (the same `Generator`) scores each answer against the
reference answer (**correctness**) and against the retrieved context
(**faithfulness**), and flags any unsupported claim as **hallucination**.

```text
=== Generation Evaluation ===
  mean_correctness: 1.000   mean_faithfulness: 1.000   hallucination_rate: 0.000
```

## Tests

```bash
uv run pytest
```

Covers the loader, chunker, embedder, retriever (RRF ranking), and the
evaluation metrics/harness, using hermetic fakes (no model downloads).

## Configuration

`config/llm_config.yaml` controls the pipeline:

- `embeddings.backend: local` → `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` via sentence-transformers;
  `openrouter` → `openai/text-embedding-3-small` via the OpenRouter API.
- `models[0]` → `openai/gpt-4o-mini` chat model, request timeouts, sampling.

The knowledge corpus lives in `data/policies/` (markdown). Chunks are built
with a recursive character splitter (defaults: `chunk_size=1000`,
`overlap=100`); the vector index persists to `data/chroma`.
